_comment: FY2025 grounded actuals (bank schema). Source: Emirates NBD FY2025 results announcement (emiratesnbd.com), confirmed by Khaleej Times / TradeArabia, Jan 2026. Net profit AED 24.0bn (+4% YoY; profit-before-tax AED 29.8bn +10%, the gap reflecting UAE corporate tax). Total income AED 49.3bn (+12%): NII AED 35.5bn (+10%), non-funded income AED 13.8bn (+18%). Total assets AED 1.164trn (+17%); customer deposits AED 786bn (+18%, +AED 119bn). ROE 18.83%; CET1 14.4%; NPL 2.4%; cost-income 30.5%. Proposed dividend 100 fils/sh. EPS and total CAR omitted (post-split share-count / total-CAR not cleanly disclosed in the release — grounding stays on firmly-sourced figures).
